title: Read CI history at a glance in story comparison and test Proof

intentCoverage.report:
Dough Intent Coverage — SEED-331#read-ci-history-at-a-glance ("Read CI history at a glance in story comparison and test Proof"), revision fa84adcf12094840d13d2c8191b58bcb79fbb945.

Verdict: Caught (limited to the scoped glance API projection path).

Promise checked: Scope "Place failed builds on a separate row below the duration axis with a red ×. Use a distinct hollow mark for unavailable timing" and Key example 1 "A failed build and a missing measurement appear as distinct dated marks". For the test-scope charts the mark kind follows the typed status the server projection sends: dashboard/src/IntentScopeTimingHistoryUnits.tsx:82 draws `gapStatus(gap?.status === "failed", …)`, so a failed build typed "unavailable" is drawn as a hollow "No timing · Failed CI build" mark instead of a red ×.

Fault: dashboard/server/ciHistoryGlance.ts `gapOf` (line 117), `reason === failedBuildReason` changed to `reason !== failedBuildReason` (caller's suggested flip, validated against the revision). Fixtures and assertions left as they were.

Independent wrong-behavior observation: a scratch Node witness ran the faulted `scopeHistoryGlanceOf` (esbuild bundle in the job tmp dir) on one "Failed CI build" gap and one "Expired CI proof summary" gap. The failed build came back `status: "unavailable"` (entry gap and case reading), and the expired one came back `status: "failed"`. Through the consumer above, the failed build would be drawn hollow and the unavailable one as a red ×. The routed chart-marks spec separately proves that status "unavailable" draws the hollow below-axis mark with a "No timing · <reason>" readout.

Maintained checks examined (focused command, same in all three runs):
`PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH caffeinate -s -i env -u NO_COLOR -u FORCE_COLOR -u GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES npm run test:dashboard -- --workers=2 --reporter=list dashboard/backend-tests/intent/ci-history-slim-response.spec.ts dashboard/tests/intent/intent-scope-glance.spec.ts dashboard/frontend-tests/intent-ci-history-chart-marks.spec.ts`
- Baseline: 5/5 passed (Playwright 1.1m). Reach: the scoped slim-response test reads the real local authenticated history boundary over retained history whose run 5 is a failed landing (dashboard/backend-tests/support/retainedGlanceHistory.ts).
- Faulted: 1 failed, 4 passed (40.0s). The catch was dashboard/backend-tests/intent/ci-history-slim-response.spec.ts:148, `expect(glance.entries.find((entry) => entry.kind === "gap")).toEqual({… readings: [{… status: "failed" …}], gap: { status: "failed", reason: "Failed CI build" } })` in test "the glance capability sends scoped dated readings, typed gaps, segments and provenance…". The diff showed both `"status": "failed"` received as `"unavailable"`.
- The other checks stayed green under the fault without exercising it. dashboard/tests/intent/intent-scope-glance.spec.ts (real-server drill-down) has no failed build in its fixture (scopePriorReferenceHistory with only measured timings). dashboard/frontend-tests/intent-ci-history-chart-marks.spec.ts routes a pre-typed ScopeHistoryGlance (dashboard/tests/support/scopeHistoryMarksScenario.ts), so it bypasses the server projection.
- Restored: the backed-up original file was copied back. `git status --porcelain` matched the empty pre-probe record, and `git diff --quiet` was clean. The same command passed 5/5 (45.3s).

Claim bound: maintained proof catches this fault at the API projection (typed status in the scoped glance response). No examined maintained check drives a real-server projection with a failed build through to the drawn scope-chart mark. That end-to-end link rests on the backend assertion plus the routed chart-marks proof of typed-status drawing. The Done wall-time chart, the compact readout's `reasonStatus` (dashboard/src/ciHistoryChart.ts:61–67) and project wall-time gaps were not probed. The caller's second known gap (real scope pending wording through a real projection) was not examined in this one-fault check.

Next proof action: none required for this fault. If the caller wants the drawn-mark link proven end to end, the narrowest addition is one failed build in a real-server scope journey fixture (e.g. the intent-scope-glance drill-down) with a check of its red × mark.

Prior disposition recognized (not a new repair decision from this probe): SEED-331#make-ci-glance-wording-and-status-one-rule (plan 613) already plans to "carry the failed status from where the build state is known instead of matching reason strings". This probe shows the current string match is guarded at the projection by ci-history-slim-response.spec.ts:148. It does not change that plan.

Costs:
- Test runtime: measured, Playwright-reported wall time for the focused command. Baseline 1.1 min, faulted 40.0 s, restored 45.3 s (≈ 2.4 min in total). Native setup time was not separately measured.
- Human effort: unavailable.
- Agent effort: unavailable.
- Invocation-to-report elapsed: 322892 ms (measured).

## Wrap-up disposition

Checked revision: fa84adcf12094840d13d2c8191b58bcb79fbb945 (one probe; it does not cover the whole story).
Evidence: faulted run failed only `dashboard/backend-tests/intent/ci-history-slim-response.spec.ts:148`; real-server scope journey and routed chart-marks spec did not exercise the fault.
Decision: no delivered defect. The optional end-to-end gap (a failed build drawn as a red × through a real-server scope journey) fits the queued retrospective follow-up's outcome, so its slice 2 proof was extended within that outcome and its readiness reassessed (ready); one queue entry kept, first in the Backlog list.
Follow-up: [Make CI glance wording and failed status one rule](../seeds/SEED-331-read-ci-history-at-a-glance.md#make-ci-glance-wording-and-status-one-rule) — SEED-331#make-ci-glance-wording-and-status-one-rule.
